assumptions.assumption: slot_mapping entries are the authoritative token-to-cache slots and negative entries are skipped
assumptions.notes: Wrong mapping or padding convention corrupts another sequence's KV cache.

assumptions.assumption: the original key cache layout is x-packed so head_size/x and x agree between writers and readers
assumptions.notes: If a backend reads NHD/HND while writer used x-packed layout, attention reads scrambled keys.

assumptions.assumption: dependent kernels launched after cache writes see those global-memory stores
assumptions.spec_excerpt: driver must invalidate global L1 cache lines between dependent grids
assumptions.notes: The PTX memory model documents dependent-grid visibility through cache invalidation; same-kernel inter-CTA ordering is not assumed.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer/XQA paged cache metadata page table and layout match vLLM block tables
assumptions.notes: FlashInfer documents paged K/V cache shapes and page_table contract; vLLM must translate block tables correctly.

assumptions.assumption: NVIDIA warp width is 32 for WARP_SIZE-based lane arithmetic and reductions
assumptions.spec_excerpt: width ... must be ... less than or equal to warpSize
assumptions.notes: The kernel hard-codes 32; a different warp size would break lane/warp indexing and reduction widths.

assumptions.assumption: all lanes named by the full shuffle mask execute the same shuffle reductions
assumptions.spec_excerpt: For all shuffle functions, the width field specifies the width of the shuffle
assumptions.notes: The sync shuffle contract supports warp register exchange only for participating lanes; divergence would make the full mask unsafe.

assumptions.assumption: shared memory is sized for FP32 logits plus reduction scratch
assumptions.code_evidence: 0deacbce6:csrc/attention_kernels.cu:67-69: extern __shared__ char shared_mem[]; We use FP32 logits
assumptions.notes: Underallocating dynamic shared memory causes overlap/OOB; overuse reduces occupancy.

assumptions.assumption: one CTA computes one sequence/head decode query
assumptions.notes: The wrapper must launch grid dimensions in that order; otherwise heads/sequences are mixed.

assumptions.assumption: partitioned softmax is valid only when every partition emits max_logit and exp_sum state
assumptions.notes: Missing either state makes log-sum-exp merging mathematically invalid.

assumptions.assumption: the second reduce kernel observes all tmp_out/exp_sums/max_logits written by the first kernel
assumptions.spec_excerpt: driver must invalidate global L1 cache lines between dependent grids
assumptions.notes: Correctness depends on two-kernel phase ordering, not an unsupported grid-wide sync inside one kernel.

assumptions.assumption: PARTITION_SIZE=0 disables partitioning, positive values exactly tile context chunks
assumptions.code_evidence: 928de468:csrc/attention/attention_kernels.cu:76,96: Zero means no partitioning; USE_PARTITIONING = PARTITION_SIZE > 0
assumptions.notes: Wrong partition sizing drops or duplicates KV blocks.

assumptions.assumption: finite-precision LSE merges are accepted within test tolerances rather than bitwise determinism
assumptions.notes: Different partition orders change rounding; no public spec promises bitwise equality for split-KV softmax.

assumptions.assumption: selected FlashAttention version supports the device architecture before dispatch
assumptions.notes: Wrong version selection can call kernels unsupported by the GPU or miss faster FA3/FA4 paths.

assumptions.assumption: paged KV block_table is forwarded to FlashAttention kernels when paged cache is used
assumptions.notes: Without block_table, FlashAttention would treat paged KV as contiguous.

assumptions.assumption: online softmax/LSE output can be merged with other attention states under tolerated floating-point error
assumptions.notes: Algebraic equivalence is clear, but exact reduction order and backend precision are validated by tests, not bitwise specification.

assumptions.assumption: FA4 compile-from-specs path is CUDA-only and not available on ROCm
assumptions.notes: ROCm dispatch must avoid this path or fail at import/compile time.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer plan metadata must encode paged-KV indptr, indices, last-page lengths and page_size
assumptions.notes: Incorrect planning metadata routes queries to wrong pages or prefix levels.

assumptions.assumption: wrappers and workspace buffers persist across plan/run and graph replay
assumptions.notes: Recreating wrappers/workspaces can invalidate cached plan state and graph-captured addresses.

assumptions.assumption: cascade outputs with LSE are merged using max/LSE rescaling
assumptions.notes: Cascade/shared-prefix correctness depends on merging prefix and suffix probabilities on the same softmax scale.

assumptions.assumption: decode and prefill spans stay separable after V1 reorder_batch
assumptions.code_evidence: L3-moves-final.json PR #16684 excerpt: all decode tokens are at the front
assumptions.notes: Plan/run benefits and correctness rely on contiguous phase chunks.

assumptions.assumption: XQA API requires documented query/KV dtypes and page sizes
assumptions.code_evidence: vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py:818: Unexpected FlashInfer page size ... without trtllm-gen GQA
assumptions.notes: Unsupported page_size/dtype combinations must fall back or assert.

assumptions.assumption: SM90 XQA decode uses BF16/FP16 query even when native prefill uses FP8-Q
assumptions.code_evidence: vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py:804-806: prefill and decode kernels support different Q dtypes
assumptions.notes: Phase-aware dtype handling prevents FP8 query mismatch in XQA decode.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer exposes TRTLLM generated decode API before vLLM dispatches to it
assumptions.notes: Absent or incompatible FlashInfer wheels break this specialized dispatch.

assumptions.assumption: supported GQA/head geometry is enforced mainly by backend tests and assertions, not a complete public matrix
assumptions.notes: The public docs state shapes but not vLLM's full dispatch matrix; unsupported geometry caused historical adapter failures.

assumptions.assumption: Triton JIT kernels can access only arguments, Triton builtins and Python primitives
assumptions.spec_excerpt: will only have access to: python primitives ... arguments
assumptions.notes: Metadata required by unified attention must be explicit kernel arguments/constexprs.

assumptions.assumption: num_queries_per_kv is a power of two and GQA heads are laid out contiguously
assumptions.notes: Tensor-core packing and pointer arithmetic assume this GQA layout.

assumptions.assumption: block_tables_ptr and sequence metadata cover every KV page for arbitrary query lengths
assumptions.notes: Missing page metadata causes OOB reads or dropped prefix tokens.

assumptions.assumption: Triton compile-time specialization keys are stable for constexpr head/page metadata
assumptions.spec_excerpt: jit’d function is called, arguments are implicitly converted to pointers
assumptions.notes: Changing constexpr metadata creates new compilations; unsafe variation under one compiled kernel breaks addressing.

assumptions.assumption: AMD wavefront/warpSize can be 64, so reductions and lane masks must match target device
assumptions.spec_excerpt: AMD devices return 64 for gfx9 and 32 for gfx10 and above
assumptions.notes: ROCm kernels cannot blindly inherit NVIDIA WARP_SIZE=32 assumptions.

assumptions.assumption: MFMA variants require compiler-recognized AMD GCN builtins outside portable HIP language docs
assumptions.spec_excerpt: warpSize should not be assumed to be a specific value
assumptions.notes: HIP documents warpSize and shared memory, not these clang AMD builtins; portability rests on compiler behavior.

assumptions.assumption: unsupported dtype/template combinations are rejected at compile time
assumptions.notes: Prevents silent execution with MFMA instructions for unimplemented types.

assumptions.assumption: ROCm paged attention consumes the same block_tables paging interface
assumptions.notes: Framework allocator/block table contract must match CUDA and ROCm backends.

assumptions.assumption: the model's projections permit MLA rewrite from MHA to latent-vector MQA
assumptions.code_evidence: L3-moves-final.json PR #12528 excerpt: computing MQA using latent vectors instead of MHA
assumptions.notes: If model weights/dimensions are not absorbable, the algebraic rewrite changes semantics.

assumptions.assumption: FlashMLA dense metadata/scheduler requires backend-specific q_lens and scheduler_metadata
assumptions.notes: Scheduler metadata drives tile assignment; stale or wrong metadata corrupts decode.

assumptions.assumption: FlashMLA/CUTLASS CUDA-graph path uses persistent tile scheduler metadata buffers
assumptions.notes: Graph replay needs stable buffer addresses while values may be updated.

assumptions.assumption: Blackwell CUTLASS MLA path assumes TMA/warp-specialized kernels are available on target architecture
assumptions.notes: Local code names the SM100 path, but this audit did not find a concise public CUTLASS contract for all scheduler metadata fields.

assumptions.assumption: FP8 cache insert requires scale tensors with correct type, device and cardinality
assumptions.code_evidence: csrc/libtorch_stable/cache_kernels.cu:1053-1063: requires kv_scales; float32; one scale per layer
assumptions.notes: Wrong scales silently dequantize K/V to wrong magnitudes.

assumptions.assumption: PTX conversion instructions define conversion as an explicit operation, but vLLM still must supply correct FP8 format/scales
assumptions.spec_excerpt: possibly converting it from one format to another
assumptions.notes: The ISA supports conversion instructions; numerical meaning depends on matching FP8 encoding and scale.

assumptions.assumption: FlashInfer XQA permits FP8 K/V cache with query dtype constraints
assumptions.notes: Dispatch must enforce dtype restrictions for XQA/TRTLLM paths.

assumptions.assumption: ROCm gfx942 FNUZ/OCP FP8 encoding differences are not covered by CUDA PTX FP8 docs
assumptions.code_evidence: L3-moves-final.json known failure: gfx942 FP8/FNUZ sparse MLA functional failures
assumptions.notes: The code handles platform variants, but public spec evidence checked here did not establish equivalence.

assumptions.assumption: CUDA graph replay needs persistent memory addresses; only values in those buffers may change
assumptions.spec_excerpt: CUDA Memory addresses are fixed, however values ... can change
assumptions.notes: Persistent scheduler/page buffers are necessary for safe replay.

assumptions.assumption: full vs piecewise CUDA graph support is an explicit backend capability
assumptions.notes: Over-advertising graph support captures unsupported dynamic shapes.

assumptions.assumption: FA3 cascade graph replay must use scheduler metadata matching capture-time num_splits
assumptions.code_evidence: vllm/v1/attention/backends/flash_attn.py:856-866: 0 means ... not CG compatible; set num_splits when using cuda graphs
assumptions.notes: Mismatch was a known cascade failure; replay with different splits reads different scratch layout.

assumptions.assumption: metadata copies on non-default streams require explicit synchronization/recording
assumptions.code_evidence: vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py:462: XQA and wrapper decode plan from qo_indptr_cpu
assumptions.spec_excerpt: using non-default streams ... user’s responsibility to ensure proper synchronization
assumptions.notes: Async H2D metadata updates must be ordered before captured kernels consume them.
